name: skeleton-loader
title: Skeleton Loader
description: A free React skeleton loader that behaves. One highlight sweeps across the whole layout as a single wave instead of every block shimmering alone, the real content blurs in when it arrives, and screen readers hear Loading and then Loaded through a polite live region with aria-busy on the wrapper. Build placeholders from Skeleton, SkeletonText and SkeletonAvatar.
